text:
Nina P: Follow-up from the rollback postmortem: the feature flag ramp went to 40% by mistake. Need owners for auto-rollback, blast-radius caps, and approval gates.

Evan L: I'll take auto-rollback. Plan: metric detector + safe-flip API + audit event. Prototype by Thu, canary next Mon.

Kai T: I'll design blast-radius caps. Proposal: three-tier caps (tenant/cluster/global) and a max-exposure floor. Will post design doc tomorrow.

Sophie M: I'll update the postmortem tracker and add recurring check-ins (2w, 6w). Also adding a regression test to CI that simulates flag misconfig.

Nina P: Two constraints: rollbacks must be idempotent and require audit logs; any change >10% needs two approvals. Evan, add dry-run mode so canary validates metrics without flipping.

Evan L: Agreed. Detection rule draft: when error_rate > 0.02 for 3m OR p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m -> safe-flip to 0%, notify oncall, emit incident marker. Dry-run toggles notify only.

Kai T: Also proposing per-user throttle on flag API to avoid rapid cascading changes. I'll include that in limiter PR.

Sophie M: Action items (brief): auto-rollback (Evan) due Thu; blast-radius caps (Kai) due Wed; approval gate + docs (Nina/Evan) due next Fri; throttling (Kai) due sprint start; postmortem tracker reminders (Sophie) scheduled.

DeployBot: Postmortem attached: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-1301

Nina P: Good. Please drop PR links here when open and ping if blocked.
